question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (3)
solution:
The correct answer is '**adverse**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage discusses the harmful impacts of sand and dust storms on health, environment, and economies.
 
• The appropriate adjective should indicate negative or harmful effects caused by these storms.
 
• "**Adverse**" fits well as it denotes harmful or unfavorable effects, which aligns with the context.
 
• Other options like "**partake**", "**lousy**", and "**puny**" do not fit the context of describing the significant harmful impacts of these storms.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.
